advances.proof_transaction: Execute one accepted workload across an adjacent scale chain, attribute movement, synchronization, retry, latency, energy, occupied allocation, utilization, and failure domains to each seam, and preserve complete-system EVP refusal.
qualified_invariants: adjacent scale domains form an explicit contiguous chain
every seam has normalized movement, coordination, latency, energy, volume, utilization, and failure fields
dominant seams and cumulative tax are deterministic and sealed
reference, simulated, and measured evidence remain distinct
scale comparison cannot authorize complete-system advantage

advances.proof_transaction: Seal one venue-neutral workload packet, verify raw returns and accepted output locally at two distinct reference venues, and prove venue substitution without transferring acceptance authority.
qualified_invariants: submission identity is stable across venue replacement
provider authority is execution_only and service completion is not acceptance
raw returned artifacts, manifests, logs, and provider receipt gate local acceptance
cancelled, faulted, refused, completed-but-wrong, and completed-and-accepted states remain distinct
two digest-identical locally accepted venue returns prove bounded substitution

advances.proof_transaction: Map workload, device, calibration, environment, power, thermal, and accepted-output events from two clock domains into one bounded interval, resolve explicit causal edges under uncertainty, and retain separate reference and measured evidence tiers.
qualified_invariants: reference, simulated, and measured clock evidence remain distinct
local timestamps, mappings, rate corrections, and uncertainty produce one common interval
causal order is proven from non-overlapping uncertainty bounds rather than display order
calibration and environment precede work and power observations bracket the work interval
accepted output, trace manifests, determinism class, entropy custody, and blockers are sealed together
causal custody cannot authorize physical-compute or complete-system EVP claims

claim_boundary: The advances close deterministic software-reference contracts for scale seams, remote venues, and causal custody. They do not establish measured scale behavior, external venue participation, physical execution, complete-system EVP advantage, or independent physical acceptance.
control_question: Can measured models, actual RTL, synchronized instruments, physical entropy, and external venues replace the reference implementations without changing the pylon invariants, accepted work, fallback, refusal, receipts, or historical custody?
